correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md §§1–5. Modulo the radical only directed-cycle rotations survive. For an idempotent lift e_i+u_i, idempotence restricts u_i to the incoming and outgoing arrows, and summing the lifts forces opposite coefficients at each arrow's two endpoints. These coefficients give the unique inner translation by 1+x. Thus square-one requires h²=1 and x∈ker(1+h)=im(1−h), so translation conjugacy removes x. For a given diagonal sign pattern there are q^r lifts, and rotations give precisely the p patterns in its necklace. The half-turn admits q−1 choices of multiplier and q translation choices per arrow pair, and the reciprocal multipliers can all be scaled to one. The fixed idempotent and arrow orbit sums multiply as the quotient directed cycle with radical square zero; in particular for n=4 this means two idempotents and one arrow in each direction. The diagonal fixed algebra retains exactly the positive arrows. These dimensions give the stated polynomial; the all-negative and half-turn classes have weights q^n and q^n+O_n(q^{n−1}), respectively, while other diagonal classes total O_n(q^{n−1}). The identity contributes one at dimension 2n. Inspected the matrix checker and stored output in artifacts/; these corroborate finite instances but do not test the general fixed-algebra isomorphism types, which are established by the basis calculation.
